A community event to discover and reconnect with the alleyways of Hanno. "4th Ichōme Alleyway Play" brings together people of all ages to enjoy traditional games and activities in the alleyways.

【Date & Time】October 11, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
【Admission】Free
【Activities】Street chalk drawing, traditional games (spinning tops, battling tops, cup-and-ball, origami, hula hoops, Japanese flipping card game), go and shogi, sign-maker's fun activities, paper theater and picture book exchange
【Weather】Rain or shine. If postponed, the event will be held on October 12 (Mon, national holiday)

For more information: Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association (https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e7%ac%ac4%e5%9b%9e%e3%80%80%e4%b8%80%e4%b8%81%e7%9b%ae%e8%b7%af%e5%9c%b0%e3%81%82%e3%81%9d%e3%81%b3)
